item.title: PALACE OF WESTMINSTER BLACK HISTORY MONTH 2018
item.description: On Friday the 26th of October 2018 for the sixth consecutive year, figures from across the diaspora came together to share incites into black history and put forward strategies to create new opportunities. It is indeed a testament to founder and organiser Tony Tokunbo Eteka Fernandez, who’s hard work and dedication has driven this project to new levels.
